text:
Arjun Patel: seeing intermittent packet loss in west gpu-pool, gRPC streams to model shards dropping ~1-2% of requests for ~20-40s, every few hours. affects only west region, bursty around heavy inference batches.
Maria Gomez: any common factor? same AZs, same instance type, or only GPU nodes?
Arjun Patel: same instance class (g4-like), only nodes behind the geneve overlay. host-level retransmits go up. pods that use long-lived gRPC streams see reconnects.
Tom Li: can you paste ifconfig/tcpdump?
Arjun Patel: quick tcpdump from one of the affected nodes: 
```
12:34:10.123456 IP 10.0.12.45.45321 > 10.0.8.31.50051: Flags [P.], seq 1:1401, ack 1, win 64240, options [nop,nop,TS val 123456 ecr 123450], length 1400
12:34:10.123458 IP 10.0.12.45.45321 > 10.0.8.31.50051: Flags [.], ack 1, win 64240, length 0
12:34:10.123789 IP 10.0.12.45 > 10.0.8.31: GREv0, length 1600 (fragmented/encrypted)
... lots of retransmits and occasional ICMP "Frag needed" from TOR switch
```
Arjun Patel: kernel dmesg shows some tx timeout on nic0 around the same time.
Maria Gomez: what are MTU settings on the host and geneve?
Arjun Patel: host mtu 9000, geneve0 mtu 8980. kube CNI configured for 8500 overlay to account for encap.
Tom Li: do we have offloads enabled? sometimes large encapsulated packets + GSO/GRO on overlay break with some NIC drivers/firmware. run: `ethtool -k nic0` and `ethtool -k geneve0`
Arjun Patel: output snippet: 
```
# ethtool -k nic0
rx-checksumming: on
tx-checksumming: on
scatter-gather: on
gso: on
 tso: on
gro: on
# ethtool -k geneve0
rx-checksumming: off
tx-checksumming: off
scatter-gather: on
gso: on
tso: on
gro: on
```
Maria Gomez: likely root cause = encapsulated packets become > host MTU due to GSO/TSO on geneve and some TOR/leaf path can't handle the UDP+geneve larger frames, causing fragmentation and packet drops. we've seen similar with older mellanox firmware.
Tom Li: quick mitigation to validate: disable GSO/TSO/GRO on geneve iface: `ethtool -K geneve0 gso off tso off gro off` then run a synthetic workload (iperf or our inference replay) and watch retransmits.
Arjun Patel: did that on one node, re-ran a 30m load test (same batch patterns) — retransmits dropped ~90% and no gRPC disconnects during the window.
sre-bot: deploy scheduled: canary kernel/firmware upgrade cherrypick for west pool at 03:00 UTC (trial on 5 nodes).
Infra-ops: follow-ups: 1) coordinate firmware vendor check (Mellanox) for offload bug 2) schedule canary roll with ethtool-change automation 3) add an e2e probe that simulates large UDP+geneve flows to catch regression.
Maria Gomez: long-term options: 1) enforce smaller segs on hosts (reduce GSO windows) 2) upgrade NIC firmware/kernel patch that handles large encaps interactions 3) tune overlay MTU conservative default (e.g., 8400) + validate pktsize accounting in our batching.
Tom Li: agree. also add a quick healthcheck alert: spike in host tx_retransmit_rate OR sustained ICMP fragmentation should page oncall.
Arjun Patel: for now rolling the ethtool change as a canary on west-gpu-canary group. I'll collect perf traces.
Maria Gomez: @Arjun Patel ping me when you have canary results, we'll decide firmware vs config. :thumbsup:
Arjun Patel: noted — will update thread with numbers and tcpdump after 03:30 UTC.
